description: One explanation, three files. The same background — the completion flag is recomputed server-side rather than stored, so a local patch hides the redirect until the next session — is told in the use case, the screen model and the HTTP query, reworded each time. The fact itself is kind 1 and earns a place: it is another service's behaviour, unknowable from this repo. What fails is that it exists three times, so two copies can drift into lying. This is invisible to a reviewer reading one file at a time, and to the author, because each copy reads reasonably where it sits. Modelled on a real PR that carried seven copies of one paragraph. The advisor must report the duplication once and name the files.
